description: This file defines the UpdateUI class, providing static methods for determining weather icon identifiers based on conditions and time, and translating day names into localized strings within an Android weather app.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: Utility class with static methods to update UI elements based on weather conditions and localization.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the weather icon based on condition codes and time of day.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates day names into localized strings using Android resources, based on the current locale.
